avis.titre: Comparison Review: Night Extreme vs. Daily Cleansing PadsComparison Review: Night Extreme vs. Daily Cleansing Pads
avis.texte: These Extreme pads are a true MUST-HAVE beauty item!!! I've ordered this product so many times I thought it time to write a review extolling the many benefits! I use these exfoliating pads on my face & neck as well as the backs of my arms where I get keratosis pilaris (aka. "chicken skin" see pic). I use them nightly and when I run out or forget for say, a week or so, my KP starts to come back so I KNOW they are VERY EFFECTIVE! About Nip + Fab Glycolic Fix Pads in General: - Contains 60 pads, or 2 months worth if used once daily. - Very thin, kinda see-though - About the size of a standard cotton round, measuring 55mm diameter. - Premoistened damp but not dripping. - A slightly pocked texture makes them easy to hold onto & friction keeps them stuck to your fingers while applying. - The lid keeps them moist until the very last one (they don't dry out like other pads do). (WINNER) Nip + Fab Glycolic Fix NIGHT EXTREME pads: - Have a nice, very subtle almost citrus smell that feels fresh. - Contains AHAs (Alpha Hydroxy Acid) 5% Glycolic Acid and Lactic Acids for exfoliation of acne scars, wrinkles & sun damage - usually products contain anywhere from 2-20% so 5% is a little weak but good for daily use. - Contains BHA (Beta Hydroxy Acid) Salicylic Acid as an exfoliant for reducing active acne - usually found at a 2% concentration in more over-the-counter cosmetics. I have always had horrible skin. It is very acne prone, dry, dull, peeling in spots, and when I wake up in the morning you can literally see all of the disgustingness clogging the pores of my face. I recently stopped taking hormonal birth control and my skin has gotten ten times worse. Typically I use a benzoyl peroxide cleaner with a rotating brush. That works wonders but since my skin is now getting worse even that is having a hard time keeping up. I purchased some salicylic acid pads in hopes that the benzoyl peroxide would kill any bacteria and the salicylic acid would help exfoliate the dead skin cells but they have never really worked well for me and this time was no exception. They help to exfoliate, but they always leave my skin dry, tight and shiny. I decided I needed to try something different so I purchased these glycolic pads. I wasn't sure what to expect when I bought them so I was really pleasantly surprised when they worked so well. These pads contain both glycolic acid as well as salicylic acid and the combination has really made a difference in my skin. I am noticing my pimples don't last as long, my face is brighter and overall my skin looks much healthier. The pads have a citrus smell to them. The pads themselves are not as abrasive as a typical salicylic acid pad which after some research I have learned is a good thing. avis.titre: Love these pads! Best exfoliating pads that are affordable!Love these pads! Best exfoliating pads that are affordable!
avis.texte: I previously was using (and liked) the St. Ives exfoliating pads, but they were unfortunately discontinued. So I wanted to find a reasonably priced alternative that would perform similar to the way the St. Ives pads did, and found these. I already bought and used an entire container of these and they are the best exfoliating pads I have found that are reasonably priced! They are an even better deal here on amazon, although they do sell these in the store. I originally tried the “Philosophy” brand “Microdelivery Microdermabrasion peel pads” a few years ago, but they have since changed the packaging and quantity and the price is way too high for me to afford. So I searched for a “dupe” of that product and found the St.Ives ones (now discontinued). I then searched again, and the Nip and Fab brand (these) had good reviews so I decided to try them, and I do not regret it! I definitely recommend these pads to anyone looking for an affordable alternative to other brands exfoliating pads, as I’ve found that these work just as well! I also feel that these have helped clear my skin and make it much smoother! Edit: I have since bought these pads 3 times and now plan on purchasing again- they are great! They have really helped my acne and acne scars and just re-texturizing my skin overall, and they can be used everyday. Love these pads and the price is also reasonable! I also tried the Pixi glow pads which were more expensive and did not like them as much as these...in short, these are t

This is my first time using glycolic acid. First, I just wanna say that the box is way smaller than I expected..... very tiny like less than the palm of your hand. Second, the pads are not wet enough. I wish there was more product in the container to rewet the pads if needed. You might have to use 2 pads to feel like you even got enough product on your face. By the time I get to my forehead, the pad is always dry. Lastly, I will say I feel my skin is more exfoliated and softer but this concentration seems way too low for me since I don't have sensitive skin. But if you have very sensitive skin, I would recommend this as a starting point because it won't be too harsh. As for me, I'm going to go up to 10%. Overall, this product would work best for beginner glycolic acid users with very sensitive skin- if you have normal skin you can probably get away with starting out with a higher concentration, maybe 8-10%.

Absolutely awesome product! This on top of my usual regimen of wash, tone and moisturize ( I use Mary Kay or Origins usually) has completely cleared up my adult acne! I developed a large amount of blackheads, small pimples and large cyst-like pimples around my jaw and neckline after my hysterectomy and nothing would clear it up. I've literally spent hundreds of dollars on every product I could find and this is the only one that has worked. It's not an overnight miracle, but if used daily (every single day) for weeks, it will definitely show progress. I'm half way through my second container, so if there is 60 per container, then I've used approximately 90...so after three months of continued usage my skin is completely clear! It doesn't burn or irritate my sensitive skin at all. I use it after my toner and before my moisturizer every single night. I wait just a couple minutes for it to dry before applying my moisturizer. I will continue to buy this product as I love it! It actually works!!!!

its really hard to write a review on certain things especially when it comes to wipes etc. I will say this I have read some reviews that almost stopped me from buying but I went with my gut and purchased anyway. The scent is a light citrus and the pads are wet. I have read reviews that they said they were dry. So, I make an effort to grab the pad and seal the container tightly to avoid drying out. (There's enough solution but not extreme like for example a clorox wipe container where it's half full/just as a reference so you know what i mean). My skin looks good but I am using a few other serums so sometimes it's hard to pin point. I have no complaints. For $10 and you have 2 months worth of night time pads, what have you got to loose?? I also get a slight tingle which for me I know its doing something rather than nothing. Does not dry my skin, does not leave redness. Its good I will continue to use this product.

avis.titre: Great product! Make sure to wear sunscreen!!
avis.texte: Can't explain how happy I am to find these! I absolutely loved the St. Ives exfoliating pads, but was super bummed when they discontinued them a few years ago. Was recently on a skincare forum and someone brought up how much they missed using the St. Ives pads, too, when another user suggested these. So glad they did! I actually like these more than the other one and am already seeing nice results after just a short use. They really plumped my face up and I look a few yrs younger, already, & my husband commented on how nice my skin is glowing! I only use it 2x a week in the pm right now, I cleanse, tone, then just swipe the product on, then moisturize. I'm definitely going to stock up on these to make sure I always have some on hand! I really like how it's AHA/BHA in one pad. I have sensitive combo skin & do just fine with these, just a very slight tingling afterwards. The scent is very citrusy but I don't mind it, at all, and the smell goes away pretty fast. I always suggest to others to wear sunscreen daily, but definitely MAKE SURE to wear sunscreen while using this product! This product will definitely make you more sensitive to the sun, so you'll need a good sunscreen to go along with it.

This is a great product. I have a subscription to it because I use it daily and love it. It’s a great first step (after cleansing) and preps my skin to the proper pH to make my Vitamin C serum more effective.

ottimo prodotto, lo sto usando tutti i giorni su viso e décolleté, ho un problema di brufoletti e piccole discromie della pelle ( leggere cmq non grosse discromie) devo dire che da quando lo uso ( 15 gg,) la mia pelle è visibilmente migliorata, grana più sottile, pelle più liscia, le discromie e i piccoli segnetti lasciati dai brufoli che avevo toccacciato sono quasi del tutto scomparsi. un valido aiuto al ricambio cellulare. resta un prodotto delicato sulla pelle. comodo xche i dischetti sono già pre-imbevuti di soluzione, e un dischetto basta tranquillamente per passare tutto il viso, collo e décolleté.

avis.titre: Didn't think as a mid 20s guy, I would like these pads so much for my skin
avis.texte: These pads are a great addition to anyone's skincare routine (even GUYS), especially if you’re serious about maintaining clear and even skin. These pads are packed with glycolic acid, salicylic acid, and hyaluronic acid, which work together to exfoliate, even out skin tone, and tackle blemishes. Over time, you’ll notice a real difference in your skin’s texture and clarity. The key to getting the most out of these pads is consistency. Using them regularly at night helps to gradually resurface your skin, making it smoother and more refined. They’re effective yet gentle enough for nightly use, and the long-term benefits are worth the commitment. What makes these pads even better is how well they work with other night time skincare products. Pairing them with your favorite serums and moisturizers boosts their effectiveness and helps you wake up with fresher, clearer skin. If you’re into skincare and want to see real results, these pads are definitely worth trying. Personally I use a moisturiser and eye repair cream nightly, the pads are great prior to these products.

Très Déçue je m'attendais à plus de contenance pour le prix payé. C'est une Petite boîte avec de petits disques imbibés.

I’ve been a long-time user of glycolic acid peels and pads. They do help with lightening (but not completely erasing) dark spots and areas on my face. This particular product fell short of my expectations. The pads are very thin and hold just enough liquid to cover your face, and I use a second pad for my neck and chest. I leave it on for about 5-8 minutes every 3-4 days, and the peeling is minimal. My skin does get red after use but calms down after a while. I prefer a deeper peel and sturdier pads. I’ve noticed my dark spots on my face are gaining momentum again, which is not ideal, and I will have to use this more frequently. The scent is lemony (?), and not my favorite—it reminds me of cleaning products, but I can deal with it. (I’ve previously used Peter Thomas Roth pads and had to cut those in half because they were so moist and gave me a deeper peel.)

Please be careful and do a spot test!!!!! Bought this for my teen son to help with acne scar discoloration. Poor kid used it one time and within seconds his face started burning and as shown in the photo, it swelled slightly and left what looked like burn marks. After this, his skin healed underneath and then the dead layer eventually began peeling away over a week's time. This was probably the worst case scenario but seriously....do a spot test.

avis.titre: This product works as described and arrived on time
avis.texte: This product does what it is supposed to, it’s gentle yet cleans, clears and tightens pores. It also works on the top of my hands where some sunspots were starting to show. They are gradually getting less noticeable. Really like this product. The Nip + Fab pads are soft and just moist enough to not leave a dripping or sticky mess. Easy add in for my evening routine. First, I wash with cetaphil cleanser, pat dry then I use one Nip + Fab pad to wipe my face, neck and back of hands... Let dry and continue on with my evening. Will buy again when my supply runs out. I even bought the Nip + Fab scrub and it’s great too.

avis.titre: Noticeable difference in my skin.....I LOVE! :)
avis.texte: I love these glycolic extreme pads so much. They really do wonders for my skin. I have extremely sensitive skin and I've noticed no irritation from using these. I use the pads every other night and have had no redness or irritation. I have noticed a significant change in my skin though. I'm seeing a lot less acne and I also think my blackheads have decreased around my nose a lot since using these. Also, I have millia under my eyes (tiny little white bumps under the skin that stick around for foreeeever it seems) and I've even started noticing a difference in those as well. It looks like they are decreasing in size and slowly getting flatter and flatter. Seriously recommend this for anyone with skin issues they'd like to fix, even those with severely sensitive skin like myself.

My daughter has been suffering from cystic acne for years, and while her acne had gotten under control she still had some scars and discoloration. She also has very oily skin. Her dermatologist recommended buying glycolic acid pads to control the oil as well as help fade the scars. About 2 months after using it and almost all her acne scars are gone! And her skin is moisturized but not oily. Her face is the smoothest and clearest it has been in a long time and we’re both happy with the results.

avis.titre: The more I use- the better and better the results get which is extremely exciting
avis.texte: This is hands down the most effective face care product I have ever used that actually makes a noticeable difference. I'v tried many different things over the years to get a flawless complexion and it was just one let down after another. Turns out I was just using all the wrong products and simply needed some Glycolic Acid in my life, and I refuse to ever go with out it! I even use Nip + Fab Glycolic Fix scrub because I'm THAT obsessed with how effective the formulas are. They seem gentle enough to use daily too. The more I use- the better and better the results get which is extremely exciting. My skin complexion has be come more even toned, its noticeably more brighter with a healthy glow even when I wake up in the morning. My skin texture has even smoothed out. Pores are noticeably smaller, the little black heads the have been nothing but a nuisance are FINALLY being put in their place, and that place is NOT in my skin- bon voyage!! The one important step you must not skip when using this product is SPF SPF SPF and more SPF! The glycolic acid has the ability to truly transform your skin, and the sun holds the ability to ruin all the results and progress you have made on your skins appearance (sun is the skins enemy, its not worth the tan anymore) so always be sure to learn to love wearing SPF daily no matter what the weather and glow on with ya bad self =) Simply put- I cannot live without Glycolic acid, and it will remain my #1 skin care ingredient for long term skin care.

avis.titre: The best wipes for fine lines and wrinkles.
avis.texte: My fiancé has been using glycolic acid lotion and wipes since she was very young and it has helped a lot preventing wrinkles and lines. She loves those wipes and uses them a lot. She is now 51 and this is how she looks. Everyone tells her she looks younger than her age and I agree. She also wears a moisturizer with sunscreen every morning before going outside.

OMGI love this product! It's great for anyone that's wanting to begin using any type of glycolic acid product. I haven't had any irritation issues since beginning use and I've seen such an improvement in my skin! Definitely worth it and will absolutely buy again!
